newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures weaker in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures weaker in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were lower across the board in the after-hours session on Thursday, as private investors took profits after posting moderate gains during the day, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.2 yen to 1.2 yen per kilo lower than the day's close. Benchmark April was 0.7 yen down at 142.7 yen.
During the day, short-covering by trade houses gained force, sending prices in positive territory at the close.
"Firm market sentiment on technical factors, remains intact. But uncertainity over rubber stocks and the currency market may put a lid on the market," one trader said.
